narrative: Endpoint equality (e_A == s_B) is Allen's meets/temporal contact, not strict precedence. The decision document is explicit that this pair must not receive a precedes edge; broadening precedes to e_A <= s_B would be a different, unadopted definition. The existing executable before operator (patterns/exact_intervals.py) already returns NOT_SATISFIED for a contact pair under strict before, which this scenario would extend to the proposed precedes property once adopted.
